overview: The Medford City Council received a first-quarter financial report, approved a partial rescission of free cash, and tabled a supplemental budget request and a utility grant of location. The Council also passed multiple resolutions concerning public safety, traffic enforcement, sidewalk maintenance, MBTA service cuts, and Tufts University construction impacts.

items.title: First Quarter Financial Update
items.summary: Finance Director Aleesha Nunley-Benjamin presented the Q1 fiscal update showing local receipts meeting targets, and the Council voted to approve the report with several requested information amendments.

items.title: Partial Rescission of Free Cash Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a request to rescind $703,000 in free cash previously appropriated for the FY21 budget after local new growth revenue exceeded initial projections.

items.title: FY2021 Supplemental Budget Appropriation
items.summary: Tabled for one week under Council Rule 20 a proposed $740,000 supplemental budget appropriation for various municipal staffing and operational accounts.

items.title: National Grid Gas Main Grant of Location on Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Tabled for one week a public hearing on National Grid's petition to relocate a gas main on Riverside Avenue pending negotiations regarding street restoration contributions.

items.title: Comcast Grant of Location on City Hall Mall
items.summary: Approved Comcast's petition to lay underground conduit and install a vault across City Hall Mall to serve 26 City Hall Mall, subject to engineering conditions.

items.title: Dedication to Veterans and Marine Corps Birthday
items.summary: Approved a resolution dedicating the meeting to military veterans for Veterans Day and celebrating the 245th birthday of the U.S. Marine Corps.

items.title: Crosswalk and Stop Line Painting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting DPW paint crosswalks and stop lines at Tainter and Park Streets and inspect crosswalks near all city schools.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School Parking Lot Sweeping
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting DPW sweep the Roberts Elementary School parking lot.

items.title: Maintenance at Roberts Elementary School Tainter Street Entrance
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting DPW clear leaves, trim bushes, and clean soil and drains at the Tainter Street entrance to Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Sidewalk Panel Replacement and Repairs
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting sidewalk panel replacements on Park Street and Tainter Street, and inquiring about sidewalk restoration near Lawrence Memorial Hospital.

items.title: Behavioral Health Commission Ordinance
items.summary: Tabled an ordinance establishing a Promote, Prevent, Support Behavioral Health Commission to allow proposed amendments to be incorporated into the draft.

items.title: North Medford Traffic Study and Site Visit
items.summary: Approved a resolution scheduling an on-site Committee of the Whole meeting for November 21 to address speeding and cut-through traffic in North Medford.

items.title: Traffic Sign Inspection at Doonan and Park Avenues
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting police inspect stop sign visibility and increase speed enforcement at Doonan and Park Avenues.

items.title: Pedestrian Safety and Bus Operations at Winthrop Street and Playstead Road
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting pedestrian crossing signs and a Traffic Commission review of MBTA bus idling and turnarounds at Winthrop Street and Playstead Road.

items.title: MBTA Service Cut Public Meeting Notice
items.summary: Approved a resolution encouraging residents to attend an upcoming MBTA public meeting regarding proposed service cuts, including a request for a citywide robocall.

items.title: Tufts University Construction Staging and Sidewalk Access
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting Tufts University keep College Avenue sidewalks clear, adjust construction signage, and establish a contractor staging policy.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Adopted committee reports concerning the Affordable Housing Trust and the 2021 City Council leadership caucus.

items.title: Commendation for Ronald and Joanne Crotty
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Ronald and Joanne Crotty on their 50th wedding anniversary.

items.title: Tractor-Trailer Overnight Parking on Commercial Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting Medford Police investigate overnight tractor-trailer parking on Commercial Street.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Inquiry on Council Chamber Capacity
items.summary: Directed a clarified question to the City Solicitor regarding Open Meeting Law implications if Council chamber COVID-19 capacity limits are reached.
